    • of

      public static Timing of(Plugin plugin, String name, Timing groupHandler)

      Returns a handler that has a groupHandler timer handler. Parent timers should not have their start/stop methods called directly, as the children will call it for you.

      返回一个带有 groupHandler 计时处理器的处理器。父计时器不应直接调用其 start/stop 方法，因为子计时器会替你调用。

      Parent Timers are used to group multiple subsections together and get a summary of them combined 父计时器用于将多个子部分组合在一起并获取它们的汇总摘要 Parent Handler can not be changed after first call 父处理器在首次调用后不可更改
      参数:
      plugin - Plugin to own the Timing 拥有该 Timing 的插件
      name - Name of Timing Timing 的名称
      groupHandler - Parent handler to mirror .start/stop calls to 镜像 .start/stop 调用的父处理器
      返回:
      Timing Handler Timing 处理器

    • isVerboseTimingsEnabled

      public static boolean isVerboseTimingsEnabled()

      Sets whether or not the Timings should monitor at Verbose level.

      设置 Timings 是否应以 Verbose 级别监控。

      When Verbose is disabled, high-frequency timings will not be available.

      当 Verbose 被禁用时，高频计时将不可用。

      返回:
      Enabled or not 是否启用

    • setVerboseTimingsEnabled

      public static void setVerboseTimingsEnabled(boolean enabled)
      Sets whether or not the Timings should monitor at Verbose level. 设置 Timings 是否应以 Verbose 级别监控。

      When Verbose is disabled, high-frequency timings will not be available. 当 Verbose 被禁用时，高频计时将不可用。 Calling this will reset timing data. 调用此方法将重置计时数据。

      参数:
      enabled - Should high-frequency timings be reported 是否应报告高频计时

    • getHistoryInterval

      public static int getHistoryInterval()

      Gets the interval between Timing History report generation.

      获取计时历史报告生成之间的间隔。

      Defaults to 5 minutes (6000 ticks) 默认为 5 分钟（6000 刻）
      返回:
      Interval in ticks 以刻为单位的间隔

    • setHistoryInterval

      public static void setHistoryInterval(int interval)

      Sets the interval between Timing History report generations.

      设置计时历史报告生成之间的间隔。

      Defaults to 5 minutes (6000 ticks)

      默认为 5 分钟（6000 刻）

      This will recheck your history length, so lowering this value will lower your history length if you need more than 60 history windows. 这将重新检查你的历史长度，因此如果你需要多于 60 个历史窗口，降低此值将缩短你的历史长度。
      参数:
      interval - Interval in ticks 以刻为单位的间隔

    • getHistoryLength

      public static int getHistoryLength()
      Gets how long in ticks Timings history is kept for the server. 获取服务器保留计时历史的时长（以刻计）。 Defaults to 1 hour (72000 ticks) 默认为 1 小时（72000 刻）
      返回:
      Duration in Ticks 以刻为单位的时长

    • setHistoryLength

      public static void setHistoryLength(int length)
      Sets how long Timing History reports are kept for the server. 设置服务器保留计时历史报告的时长。 Defaults to 1 hours(72000 ticks) 默认为 1 小时（72000 刻） This value is capped at a maximum of getHistoryInterval() * MAX_HISTORY_FRAMES (12) 此值的上限为 getHistoryInterval() * MAX_HISTORY_FRAMES (12) Will not reset Timing Data but may truncate old history if the new length is less than old length. 不会重置计时数据，但如果新长度小于旧长度，可能会截断旧历史。
      参数:
      length - Duration in ticks 以刻为单位的时长

    • generateReport

      public static void generateReport(CommandSender sender)
      Generates a report and sends it to the specified command sender. 生成报告并将其发送给指定的命令发送者。 If sender is null, ConsoleCommandSender will be used. 若 sender 为 null，将使用 ConsoleCommandSender。
      参数:
      sender - The sender to send to, or null to use the ConsoleCommandSender 要发送到的发送者，或为 null 以使用 ConsoleCommandSender
